description: This file defines the EntityNotCondition class, which represents a negation (NOT) condition in a query expression framework within the Apache OFBiz project. It implements methods for condition evaluation, string representation, and integration with other condition components.

classes.name: EntityNotCondition
classes.description: A class representing a negated entity condition, implementing the EntityCondition interface.

methods.name: EntityNotCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the negation condition with a given EntityCondition.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to perform operations on this condition.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on the contained condition.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the condition.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the condition is empty; always returns false.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Builds the SQL WHERE clause string for this negation condition.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Validates the condition against a model entity, may throw an exception.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Determines if the condition matches a given data map, negated.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the condition.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns an immutable version of this condition.
